## Quality checklist

- [ ] I tested the changes locally (`npm run check && npm run test && npm run build`).
- [ ] The documentation distinguishes implemented features from proposals.
- [ ] No secrets, user data, private screenshots or privileged configuration are included.
- [ ] UI changes are checked for keyboard navigation and responsive behavior.
- [ ] Changes to the community catalog include public evidence and an explicit license.
